footnotes: p. 20 n. 1 (to àmṭu, l. 8): Or temṭu; see Brugsch, Wörterbuch (Suppl.), p. 76.
notes: Section: p. 19 from 'PLATE V.' l. 1 (ḥā) to the foot of the page (āāa); p. 20 from enma ṭepet to Ànnu (l. 13); nuk Ṭetṭeti se excluded. Rubric overlines on p. 19: rows 1-3 fully overlined (ḥā ... pert, i.e. l. 1 ḥā through l. 3 pert 'coming forth.'); row 4 overlined from ànet' to the end (ànet', ḥrà-k, ka); row 5 overlined over Àmentet and àn (line ends just short of the right edge of àn). t'eṭ àn Àusàr Ani Àusàr ān Ani on row 4 not overlined. No overlines on p. 20. Line numerals falling inside words: '2.' inside seχu, '6.' inside ābai - nà, '10.' inside χenrà — each word assigned to the line in which it begins. Budge's human figure: two variants printed — (a) arm bent up in V before the face (suffix, Ani det), (b) arm raised diagonally to the top of the head (dets of seθes, seχu, semaāχeru l. 6, ut'ā, t'eṭet l. 12, figure in ren-k); both coded A1 per house ruling, flagged in unsure. The open flat sign with an upright tab at the right end (forearm) is coded D36 throughout (ḥā, uā, āāa, maā groups); the closed bevelled plinth is coded Aa11 only where printed (semaāχeru l. 11). 'ic)' printed small under N35 in enma (p. 20 top) — presumably '(sic)', partly lost. Gloss for t'eṭ àn: 'Saith' spans both. Trailing full stop in 'semaāχeru.' (l. 11) dropped from budge field.
